# TSK-240: comments on tasks

People discuss tasks in chat and the context gets lost. Add comments to tasks.

## What we need
1. Storage: comments with the task, the author, the text and the time; listing the comments of a task
   must stay fast for tasks with thousands of comments.
2. `POST /tasks/:id/comments` with `{ "body": "<text>" }`: the author is the `x-user-id` user; the text is
   trimmed and must be 1-2000 characters (`400` otherwise). Returns `201` with
   `{ id, task_id, author_id, body, created_at }`. A task that does not exist gives `404`.
3. `GET /tasks/:id/comments?page=1&per_page=20`: oldest first; `page` from 1 (default 1), `per_page`
   1-100 (default 20), anything else `400`. Returns `{ items, page, per_page, total }`. A task that does
   not exist gives `404`.
4. `DELETE /comments/:id`: only the comment's author may delete it (`204`); anyone else gets `403`; a
   comment that does not exist gives `404`.
5. `GET /tasks/:id` also returns `comments_count`.
6. README and tests.
